newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat 1997 sales around 90 trln lire - Romiti.
newsitem.headline: Fiat 1997 sales around 90 trln lire - Romiti.

text.p: Italian industrial giant Fiat SpA's 1997 group sales are expected to be around 90 trillion lire, Chairman Cesare Romiti was quoted as saying.
"Forecasts for Fiat's 1997 turnover are for around 90 trillion lire," Romiti said in an interview with Turin daily La Stampa.
He said the group's current bourse capitalisation was 24 trillion lire, but gave no further details.
Fiat saw 1996 sales rise four percent to 78 trillion lire.
First quarter 1997 group sales rose 4.4 percent to 20.844 trillion lire.
